name: DDRK flow-correct ancestral and restart jump
plain: Noise injection that respects flow matching, where the signal must be scaled as well as adding noise. On EDM it uses the usual split, and restart jumps reuse this same flow-correct form when moving up in sigma.
math:
EDM: σ_up=min(σ_n, η√(σ_n²(σ²−σ_n²))/σ), σ_down=√(σ_n²−σ_up²).
Flow: σ_d=σ_n(1+(σ_n/σ−1)η), ratio=(1−σ_n)/(1−σ_d), renoise=√(σ_n²−(σ_d·ratio)²).
Restart up: x′=x·(1−σ′)/(1−σ)+n·√(σ′²−(σ(1−σ′)/(1−σ))²).
SDE noise is multiplied by flat_mask=(1−edge)·flatness, flatness=1−sigmoid(2·z(local var)), window 5.
label: from code

audit.note: SDE mask is not local_entropy_mask alone. ddrk_omega/sampler.py:2050-2052: flat_mask=((1−log_mask(x))·local_entropy_mask(x,window=5)).clamp(0,1). The mask gates only the added noise; the flow ratio still scales the whole latent (line 2058).
